page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

For acceleration tasks, the server is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 GPUs, providing a total of 16 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dense allocation of dedicated compute cores and system memory alongside entry-level enterprise GPUs, making it a viable option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the premium cost of high-end GPU architectures. It is suited for workloads such as video transcoding, inference tasks with smaller models, parallel processing, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated applications.
